author: massicomar
title: Sleeping Schedule
summary:
Vova had a pretty weird sleeping schedule. There are $h$ hours in a day. Vova will sleep exactly $n$ times. The $i$-th time he will sleep exactly after $a_i$ hours from the time he woke up. You can assume that Vova woke up exactly at the beginning of this story (the initial time is $0$). Each time Vova sleeps exactly one day (in other words, $h$ hours).

Vova thinks that the $i$-th sleeping time is good if he starts to sleep between hours $l$ and $r$ inclusive.

Vova can control himself and before the $i$-th time can choose between two options: go to sleep after $a_i$ hours or after $a_i - 1$ hours.

Your task is to say the maximum number of good sleeping times Vova can obtain if he acts optimally.

Input

The first line of the input contains four integers $n, h, l$ and $r$ ($1 \le n \le 2000, 3 \le h \le 2000, 0 \le l \le r \lt h$) — the number of times Vova goes to sleep, the number of hours in a day and the segment of the good sleeping time.

The second line of the input contains $n$ integers $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ ($1 \le a_i \lt h$), where $a_i$ is the number of hours after which Vova goes to sleep the $i$-th time.

Output

Print one integer — the maximum number of good sleeping times Vova can obtain if he acts optimally.

constraints.text: n ≤ 2000 sleeps, h ≤ 2000 hours per day

explanation: The state is (sleeps done, current hour); each sleep starts a_i or a_i − 1 hours later. n · h = 4e6 states.

extraLayers.prompt: What should the DP state represent?

options.text: dp[i][t] = max good sleeps among the first i, if the current time is hour t
dp[i][j] = max good sleeps among the first i, if exactly j of them started one hour early
options.why: Also valid: the current hour is (prefix sum − j) mod h, so j determines t.

options.text: dp[i] = max good sleeps among the first i
options.why: Loses the current hour, which decides whether the next sleep is good.

options.text: dp[t] = whether hour t is reachable
options.why: Loses both the step and the count.

extraLayers.explanation: The future depends on how many sleeps are done and what time it is now.

extraLayers.prompt: Given that state, which transition is right?

options.text: dp[i][t] = max over c ∈ {a_i, a_i − 1} of dp[i−1][(t − c) mod h] + [l ≤ t ≤ r]

options.why: The hour must move forward by a_i or a_i − 1.
Forgets mod h and to count whether this sleep is good.

options.text: Choose a_i − 1 whenever it lands in [l, r]
options.why: Greedy; an early start now can ruin later sleeps.

extraLayers.explanation: Come from the previous hour after waiting a_i or a_i − 1 hours, and add 1 if the new start time is good.

es.explanation: El estado es (sueños hechos, hora actual); cada sueño empieza a_i o a_i − 1 horas después. n · h = 4e6 estados.

dp-state.explanation: El futuro depende de cuántos sueños se hicieron y de qué hora es ahora.

why.b: También vale: la hora actual es (suma de prefijo − j) mod h, así que j determina t.
why.c: Pierde la hora actual, que decide si el próximo sueño es bueno.

dp-transition.explanation: Vienes de la hora anterior después de esperar a_i o a_i − 1 horas, y sumas 1 si la nueva hora de inicio es buena.

why.b: La hora tiene que avanzar a_i o a_i − 1.
why.c: Se olvida del mod h y de contar si este sueño es bueno.
why.d: Es greedy; empezar temprano ahora puede arruinar los sueños siguientes.
